candidates: When building a `__docgenInfo` object in the Vue plugin files (`vue-component-meta.ts`, `vue-docgen.ts`) by merging static metadata with a runtime-derived `displayName`, place the runtime fields as the **last** argument to `Object.assign` so they win: `Object.assign({}, meta, { displayName: component.name ?? component.__name ?? meta.displayName })`. Putting the static metadata object last causes its `displayName` to silently overwrite any user-defined component name, which is the opposite of the intended behaviour.
